identity.name: Hugh Malcolm
identity.summary: Jamaican drummer of the rocksteady years, named by Carlton Barrett and Santa Davis among their forerunners.

contribution.description: Santa Davis says the 'flying cymbal' was played first on 'Moonlight Lover', a Treasure Isle record of Malcolm's; Carlton Barrett put him in his own hall of fame of reggae drummers in 1983.

beatbreaker.songs_short_because: 15-b sweep (2026-10-22): Hugh Malcolm is known through session credits that are rarely documented track by track.
